arrest: You are under arrest for {crime} as you were caught in the act.

crimes.obstruction: obstructing a public official in the performance of duty

rights: You have the right to appoint a lawyer and receive assistance from your lawyer.
You have the right to explain yourself.
You have the right to remain silent.
And you have the right to request a court review of your arrest.

voluntary.identityAudio: I am a police officer. My unit and name are shown on this screen and on my police ID card.
voluntary.request: In order to ask you questions, I am asking you to accompany me as follows.

purposes.theft: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with theft
purposes.robbery: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with robbery
purposes.assault: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with assault
purposes.injury: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with causing bodily injury
purposes.fraud: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with fraud
purposes.drugs: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with a drug offense
purposes.dui: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with drunk driving
purposes.sexual_assault: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with indecent assault
purposes.immigration: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with violating the Immigration Act
purposes.obstruction: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with obstructing a public official in the performance of duty
purposes.general: Purpose: to ask you questions in connection with a crime

reasons.disadvantage: Reason: questioning you at this location would be disadvantageous to you
reasons.traffic: Reason: questioning you at this location would obstruct traffic

notice: You have the right to refuse my request to accompany me.
Even if you agree to accompany me, you are free to leave at any time while accompanying me, and you are also free to leave the place where we go.

If you accompany me, you will be given the opportunity to have your family, relatives, or others informed of the police officer's identity, the place, and the purpose and reason for accompanying me, or to contact them yourself immediately.
You also have the right to the assistance of a lawyer.
Do you understand all of these rights?
If so, do you voluntarily agree to accompany me of your own free will?

consular: You have the right to request that we notify a consular officer of your country that you have been arrested.
You also have the right to send a letter to a consular officer of your country, as permitted under the laws of the Republic of Korea.
Do you want us to notify a consular officer of your country that you have been arrested?
If yes, please say “Yes.” If not, please say “No.”
